questions.text: Physiological signals are especially valuable in affect detection because they:
options: Cannot be voluntarily controlled and reflect pure emotional states
Require full attention from the participant
Are easier to fake than facial expressions
questions.correctAnswer: Cannot be voluntarily controlled and reflect pure emotional states

questions.text: Which of the following is not a physiological measure?
Heart rate is strongly associated with which dimension of emotion?
A key advantage of PPG (Photo-Plethysmography) over ECG is that PPG:
options: Is quicker to attach and less intrusive
questions.correctAnswer: Is quicker to attach and less intrusive

options: The average heart rate over the day
The electrical intensity of heart contractions
The variation in RR intervals between beats
The number of peaks in each heartbeat waveform
questions.correctAnswer: The variation in RR intervals between beats

questions.text: A major limitation of ECG/PPG for affect recognition is that they:
options: Only measure emotional valence, not arousal
Cannot measure changes over short intervals
Are too invasive for most participants
Cannot distinguish positive from negative arousal
questions.correctAnswer: Cannot distinguish positive from negative arousal
